name: The Lord of Blackrock
summary: At Stormwind's gates, the Alliance gathers to mark a victory over Blackrock. After you report to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in Stormwind Keep, the heroes go to the Valley of Heroes, where Field Marshal Stonebridge prepares a public commemoration for the city.

sections.title: A City's Triumph
sections.body: The Alliance's campaign against the Blackrock clan and the Black Dragonflight's brood reaches its public end. After Nefarian's severed head is presented inside Stormwind Keep, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sends the champions across the city to the Valley of Heroes. Field Marshal Stonebridge waits there to receive the trophy and begin the celebrations.

sections.title: Rallying the Alliance
sections.body: Field Marshal Stonebridge raises Nefarian's severed head above the great arches at Stormwind's main entrance. The sight reaches the whole city, and the Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer inspires the defenders, visiting dignitaries, and citizens. They know Deathwing's brood has suffered a crushing blow.

faq.q: What happens when you complete this quest?
faq.answer: Field Marshal Stonebridge hangs Nefarian's severed head high on the stone gateway arch in the Valley of Heroes. The Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer then strengthens friendly fighters and guards throughout Stormwind City.

Field Marshal Stonebridge is a senior officer in Stormwind's army, stationed in the Valley of Heroes near the city's entrance. She arranges public commemorations of military victories, including the display of defeated draconic foes' heads.

faq.q: Why does Highlord Bolvar Fordragon send you here?
aliases: why go to valley of heroes
faq.answer: After receiving word of Nefarian's defeat in the throne room, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sends you to the city gates. There, the Alliance military can display the victory openly and raise morale across the capital.

faq.q: Does this turn-in affect the whole city?
faq.answer: Yes. When Stonebridge takes the trophy, a proclamation rings through Stormwind and the Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer reaches everyone within the city borders.

faq.q: Where is the Valley of Heroes located?
faq.answer: The Valley of Heroes is the grand causeway leading into Stormwind City. Towering statues line it, honoring the heroes of the Second War who entered the Dark Portal.
The black dragon Nefarian was the Lord of Blackrock. He is Deathwing's son and rules the upper spires of Blackrock Mountain.

angles.text: Nefarian's head at the Valley of Heroes brings the Alliance races together. Citizens from Ironforge, Darnassus, and Gnomeregan see that the dark forces plaguing the Eastern Kingdoms can be broken.
For the kingdom of Stormwind, defeating Blackrock's master removes a grave draconic threat from its northern border.
The Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer gives strength to fighters heading out to defend the realm.
